overall.assessment: Prema dostavljenoj strukturi, podcast ima snažnu kršćansku jezgru: usredotočen je na Krista, Božje milosrđe, molitvu, obraćenje i spremnost da se dobra stave u službu Kraljevstva Božjega. Njegova antropološka vrijednost najjasnija je u naglasku na obitelji, odgovornosti i zajedništvu, ali prikazani tematski okvir nosi rizik da se evanđeoski poziv na radikalno učeništvo zamijeni pritiskom straha ili pojednostavljenim sudom o ljudima. Posebno su pastoralno i društveno problematične tvrdnje koje odlazak mladih povezuju s mrmljanjem, a njihova stajališta s „duhom komunizma”, ako nisu pažljivo obrazložene i odvojene od političkog etiketiranja. Zato podcast djeluje djelomično usklađeno s katoličkim naukom: njegova pobožna i kristocentrična usmjerenost jest vrijedna, ali zahtijeva preciznije biblijsko tumačenje i uravnoteženiju primjenu socijalnog nauka Crkve.
seeds_of_logos: Krunica Božanskom milosrđu, litanije, molitva i otajstva krunice usmjeravaju slušatelja prema Kristovu djelu spasenja i marijanskoj pobožnosti usredotočenoj na Krista.
Poziv da se vjernik veže uz Isusa, a ne uz propovjednika, može poticati zrelu vjeru koja ne svodi Crkvu na osobnost govornika.
Naglasak na obraćenju, kršćanskoj radosti i Isusu kao jedinom Spasitelju odgovara kršćanskoj nadi, pod uvjetom da se naviješta zajedno s Božjim milosrđem, a ne kao prijetnja.
Teme obitelji kao „male crkve”, odgovornog roditeljstva i uporabe imovine u službi Kraljevstva mogu afirmirati zajedništvo, velikodušnost i odgovornost prema drugima.
Poziv na pomoć centru i svjedočanstvo o ozdravljenju mogu izraziti solidarnost i zahvalnost, ako su prikazani istinito, bez obećanja zajamčenog ozdravljenja ili pritiska na darivatelje.
concerns: Izraz „viza za raj ili viza za pakao” može stvarnost suda i ozbiljnost grijeha prikazati kao zastrašujući ultimatum ili pojednostavljenu sigurnost o nečijoj konačnoj sudbini. Katoličko naviještanje treba istodobno ozbiljno shvatiti obraćenje, slobodu i odgovornost osobe te Božje milosrđe.

Tumačenje „mrziti” oca i majku kao prezreti ljudski obzir treba jasno povezati s biblijskim semitskim načinom izražavanja i prvenstvom nasljedovanja Krista, a ne razumjeti kao dopuštenje za doslovnu mržnju, zanemarivanje roditelja ili prekid obiteljskih obveza.

Povezivanje odlaska mladih iz Hrvatske i BiH s mrmljanjem ili proklinjanjem može zanemariti složene osobne, obiteljske i gospodarske okolnosti te nepravedno moralizirati odluku o iseljavanju. Slično tome, općenita tvrdnja o „duhu komunizma” među europskom mladeži može politički obilježiti ljude umjesto da pošteno razmotri njihove konkretne argumente i uvjete.

Kritika komunizma ne bi smjela prerasti u nekritičko opravdavanje svakog poduzetništva ili ekonomskog poretka. Crkveni socijalni nauk odbacuje komunistički sustav, ali također upozorava da rast proizvodnje sam po sebi nije mjerilo stvarnog ljudskog napretka te naglašava pravednost, dostojanstvo rada i dobrobit obitelji.

Poziv na veliku obitelj, primjeren stambeni prostor i odgoj djece bez razmaženosti treba iznijeti kao razboritu primjenu kršćanskih vrijednosti, a ne kao jedini oblik vjernog obiteljskog života ili razlog za osuđivanje obitelji s drukčijim mogućnostima i okolnostima.
overall.theological_context: Biblijski okvir treba držati zajedno Kristov poziv na odricanje, vjernost i spasenje s milosrđem, ljubavlju prema bližnjemu i odgovornošću za siromašne; citirani crkveni tekstovi izričito povezuju milosrđe i društvenu pravdu, a ne dopuštaju da se jedan vid odvoji od drugoga. Socijalni nauk Crkve istodobno odbacuje komunizam kao sustav i poziva kršćane da ekonomiju prosuđuju prema dostojanstvu osobe, pravdi, obitelji i stvarnom dobru zajednice, a ne prema proizvodnji ili političkim etiketama. Dostavljeni izvori ne uključuju tekst KKC-a ili koncilskih dokumenata, pa ih ovdje ne navodim kao neposrednu potporu.

overall.assessment_en: According to the provided structure, the podcast has a strong Christian core: it is focused on Christ, God's mercy, prayer, conversion, and readiness to put goods at the service of the Kingdom of God. Its anthropological value is clearest in its emphasis on family, responsibility, and communion, but the presented thematic framework carries the risk of replacing the evangelical call to radical discipleship with the pressure of fear or a simplified judgment of people. Particularly pastorally and socially problematic are claims linking the departure of young people to grumbling, and their viewpoints to the “spirit of communism”, unless carefully substantiated and separated from political labeling. Therefore, the podcast appears partially aligned with Catholic teaching: its devout and Christocentric orientation is valuable, but it requires a more precise biblical interpretation and a more balanced application of the Church's social doctrine.
overall.theological_context_en: The biblical framework must hold together Christ's call to renunciation, faithfulness, and salvation with mercy, love of neighbor, and responsibility for the poor; the cited Church texts explicitly link mercy and social justice, and do not allow one aspect to be separated from the other. The Church's social doctrine simultaneously rejects communism as a system and calls Christians to judge the economy according to the dignity of the person, justice, the family, and the real good of the community, rather than according to production or political labels. The provided sources do not include the text of the CCC or conciliar documents, so I do not cite them here as immediate support.
seeds_of_logos_en: The Chaplet of Divine Mercy, litanies, prayer, and mysteries of the Rosary direct the listener toward Christ's work of salvation and Marian devotion focused on Christ.
The call for the believer to attach themselves to Jesus, and not to the preacher, can encourage a mature faith that does not reduce the Church to the personality of the speaker.
The emphasis on conversion, Christian joy, and Jesus as the only Savior corresponds to Christian hope, provided that it is proclaimed together with God's mercy, and not as a threat.
The themes of the family as the “domestic church”, responsible parenthood, and the use of property in the service of the Kingdom can affirm communion, generosity, and responsibility toward others.
The invitation to help the center and the testimony of healing can express solidarity and gratitude, if presented truthfully, without promises of guaranteed healing or pressure on donors.
concerns_en: The phrase “visa for heaven or visa for hell” can depict the reality of judgment and the gravity of sin as a frightening ultimatum or a simplified certainty about someone's final destiny. Catholic proclamation must simultaneously take seriously conversion, freedom, and the responsibility of the person, as well as God's mercy.

The interpretation of “hating” father and mother as despising human regard must be clearly linked to the biblical Semitic idiom and the primacy of following Christ, and not understood as permission for literal hatred, neglect of parents, or breaking family obligations.

Linking the departure of young people from Croatia and BiH to grumbling or cursing can overlook complex personal, family, and economic circumstances and unfairly moralize the decision to emigrate. Similarly, the generalized claim about the “spirit of communism” among European youth can politically label people instead of fairly considering their concrete arguments and conditions.

Criticism of communism should not turn into an uncritical justification of every entrepreneurship or economic order. Church social teaching rejects the communist system, but also warns that the growth of production in itself is not the measure of true human progress, and emphasizes justice, the dignity of work, and the well-being of the family.

The call to a large family, appropriate living space, and raising children without spoiling them should be presented as a prudent application of Christian values, and not as the only form of faithful family life or a reason for condemning families with different possibilities and circumstances.

sections.subtitle: „Tko se ne odrekne svega što posjeduje“: evanđeoski poziv na početku molitve
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar pozdravlja gledatelje i slušatelje medija Ora et Labora te izgovara misao dana iz evanđelja
sections.content:
Sto dvadeset i osma epizoda serijala **Milosrđe Božje** na kanalu Oraetlabora Međugorje počinje kratko i bez uvoda. Voditelj **Vladimir Grebenar** pozdravlja „u Gospodinu“ drage gledatelje i slušatelje medija Ora et Labora. Odmah zatim izgovara misao koja određuje ton cijele emisije.

Riječ je o retku iz evanđelja dana: **„Tko se ne odrekne svega što posjeduje, ne može biti moj učenik.“** Ta zahtjevna Isusova rečenica vodi i do naslova epizode, *„Odreći se i samoga sebe radi spasenja!“*. Ona je okvir za sve što slijedi.

Grebenar se nakon toga prekriži riječima „U ime Oca i Sina i Duha Svetoga“ i otvara dug molitveni dio. U njemu se nižu molitve za zaštitu i oslobođenje, posvete, Krunica Božanskom milosrđu, litanije i Gospina krunica sa slavnim otajstvima.

magisterium.assessment: Navod odgovara Lk 14,33 i vjerno prenosi ozbiljan Isusov poziv na učeništvo, koje zahtijeva da Krist bude iznad svih posjeda i privrženosti. Naslov je prihvatljiv ako „radi spasenja” znači odgovor vjere i predanja Kristu, a ne tvrdnju da se spasenje može zaslužiti vlastitim odricanjem.
concerns: Bez dodatnog objašnjenja naslov bi se mogao shvatiti kao da je odricanje samoga sebe uzrok ili cijena spasenja; katolički nauk naglašava Krista i njegovo spasenjsko djelo, kojemu je učeničko odricanje odgovor.
magisterium.enrichment: Isusov zahtjev ne znači da svaki kršćanin mora na isti način napustiti svu imovinu: svi su pozvani na nutarnju nevezanost i velikodušno dijeljenje, dok konkretna praksa ovisi o životnom staležu i pozivu. Katekizam utemeljuje taj poziv u tome da se Krista treba pretpostaviti svemu drugome, a Ivan Pavao II. ističe da je potpuno predanje Kristu obilježje učeništva.

magisterium.assessment_en: The quotation corresponds to Lk 14:33 and faithfully conveys Jesus' serious call to discipleship, which requires that Christ be above all possessions and attachments. The title is acceptable if “for the sake of salvation” means a response of faith and surrender to Christ, rather than a claim that salvation can be earned by one's own renunciation.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Jesus' requirement does not mean that every Christian must renounce all property in the same way: all are called to interior detachment and generous sharing, while concrete practice depends on one's state of life and vocation. The Catechism grounds this call in the fact that Christ should be preferred above all else, and John Paul II emphasizes that complete surrender to Christ is a mark of discipleship.
concerns_en: Without additional explanation, the title could be understood as if renouncing oneself were the cause or price of salvation; Catholic teaching emphasizes Christ and his saving work, to which discipleship's renunciation is a response.

sections.subtitle_en: “Whoever does not renounce all that he possesses”: evangelical call at the beginning of prayer
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar greets the viewers and listeners of the media Ora et Labora and speaks the thought of the day from the Gospel
sections.content_en:
The one hundred twenty-eighth episode of the series **Milosrđe Božje** on the Oraetlabora Međugorje channel begins briefly and without an introduction. Host **Vladimir Grebenar** greets “in the Lord” the dear viewers and listeners of the media Ora et Labora. Immediately thereafter, he speaks the thought that sets the tone of the entire broadcast.

It is a line from the Gospel of the day: **“Whoever does not renounce all that he possesses cannot be my disciple.”** That demanding sentence of Jesus also leads to the title of the episode, *“Renounce even oneself for the sake of salvation!”*. It is the framework for everything that follows.

Grebenar then crosses himself with the words “In the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit” and opens a long prayer section. In it follow prayers for protection and deliverance, consecrations, the Chaplet of Divine Mercy, litany, and Our Lady's Rosary with the glorious mysteries.

sections.subtitle: Zaštita krvlju Isusovom: molitva oslobođenja od svih sila zla
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj moli molitvu oslobođenja i stavlja obitelji pod zaštitu dragocjene krvi Isusove
sections.content:
Prva molitva u nizu izrazito je borbena, molitva oslobođenja i zaštite. Vladimir Grebenar u ime Isusovo „uzima vlast“ i „veže“ sve zle sile i snage. Kao mjesta njihova djelovanja nabraja:

- zrak i zemlju,
- vodu i podzemlje,
- „onaj svijet“,
- prirodu i vatru.

Isusa pritom ispovijeda kao **Gospodina nad svim svemirom** i daje mu slavu „u ime tvoga stvorenja“.

Molitva zatim postaje osobnija. Voditelj veže „sve demonske sile koje su došle protiv nas i naših obitelji“. Sve vjernike stavlja pod zaštitu **dragocjene krvi** koja je prolivena na križu.

U drugom dijelu molitva se obraća Mariji kao majci. Od nje se traži zaštita i zagovor kod **Presvetog Srca Isusova** za sve obitelji, uz moliteljsku sliku: „Zaogrni nas svojim plaštem ljubavi, da se prestraši neprijatelj.“ Zatim se zazivaju **sveti Mihovil i anđeli čuvari** da brane obitelji „u borbi protiv svega zla što obilazi svijetom“.

Vrhunac je zapovijed svim silama zla da „odstupe istog časa“ od molitelja, od njihovih domova i od njihove zemlje. Molitva završava zahvalom Isusu kao vjernom Bogu koji „osjeća s nama“.

magisterium.assessment: Zazivanje Isusove zaštite, njegove krvi, Marijina zagovora, svetoga Mihovila i anđela čuvara u skladu je s katoličkom molitvenom tradicijom. Ipak, govor o osobnom „uzimanju vlasti”, „vezanju” i zapovijedanju zlim silama zahtijeva oprez jer može zamagliti razliku između molitve vjernika i službenog, crkvenom ovlašću vršenog egzorcizma.
concerns: Ako molitelj nije svećenik ovlašten za službeni egzorcizam, imperativne zapovijedi demonima mogu oponašati oblik službenog egzorcizma: obred izričito nalaže vjernicima da se suzdrže od izgovaranja takve formule.
Izraz „uzima vlast” može se razumjeti kao da pojedinac raspolaže vlastitom moći nad zlim duhovima; katolička molitva treba jasno upućivati na Božju vlast i na ponizno moljenje za Božju zaštitu.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva poznaje molitve za oslobođenje i zaštitu te zazive Mariji i svetom Mihovilu; odobreni obred, primjerice, moli Boga da odbije djelovanje đavla i zaziva pomoć Blažene Djevice i anđela. Važno je razlikovati takve prošnje od službenog egzorcizma: propisana imperativna formula pripada svećeniku koji djeluje crkvenom ovlašću, a vjernici je ne izgovaraju.

magisterium.assessment_en: Invoking Jesus' protection, his blood, Mary's intercession, Saint Michael, and guardian angels is in accordance with Catholic prayer tradition. However, speaking of personally “taking authority”, “binding”, and commanding evil forces requires caution because it can blur the distinction between the prayer of the faithful and official exorcism performed by Church authority.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church knows prayers for deliverance and protection, as well as invocations to Mary and Saint Michael; the approved rite, for example, prays to God to repel the action of the devil and invokes the help of the Blessed Virgin and angels. It is important to distinguish such petitions from official exorcism: the prescribed imperative formula belongs to a priest acting by Church authority, and the faithful do not utter it.
concerns_en: If the person praying is not a priest authorized for official exorcism, imperative commands to demons can imitate the form of official exorcism: the rite explicitly instructs the faithful to refrain from uttering such a formula.

The phrase “takes authority” can be understood as though an individual possesses their own power over evil spirits; Catholic prayer should clearly point to God's authority and to humble praying for God's protection.

sections.subtitle_en: Protection by the Blood of Jesus: prayer of deliverance from all powers of evil
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host prays the prayer of deliverance and places families under the protection of the precious blood of Jesus
sections.content_en:
The first prayer in the sequence is intensely combative, a prayer of deliverance and protection. Vladimir Grebenar in the name of Jesus “takes authority” and “binds” all evil powers and forces. As places of their operation he lists:

- the air and the earth,
- the water and the netherworld,
- “the other world”,
- nature and fire.

He thereby confesses Jesus as the **Lord over all the universe** and gives Him glory “in the name of Your creation”.

The prayer then becomes more personal. The host binds “all demonic forces that have come against us and our families”. He places all faithful under the protection of the **precious blood** that was shed on the cross.

In the second part, the prayer turns to Mary as a mother. Protection and intercession with the **Sacred Heart of Jesus** for all families are sought from her, with the praying imagery: “Clothe us with your mantle of love, that the enemy may be terrified.” Then **Saint Michael and the guardian angels** are invoked to defend families “in the battle against all evil that prowls about the world”.

The climax is a command to all powers of evil to “depart at that very moment” from the prayer participants, from their homes, and from their land. The prayer ends with thanksgiving to Jesus as a faithful God who “feels with us”.

sections.subtitle: Arkanđeo Mihael i molitva da „naša srca kucaju zajedno“
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar moli molitvu svetom Mihaelu arkanđelu i prelazi na molitvu za jedinstvo s Isusom
sections.content:
Na molitvu oslobođenja nastavlja se klasična **molitva svetom Mihaelu arkanđelu**. Grebenar ga zaziva kao „vojvodu vojske nebeske“. Moli ga da vjernike brani „u boju protiv pakosti i zasjeda đavolskih“ i da im bude zaklon. Molitva traži da Sotonu i druge zle duhove, koji „svijetom obilaze na propast duša“, božanskom kreposti i jakošću strovali u pakao.

Slijedi molitva drukčijeg, nježnog tona, upućena „ljupkom Isusu“. Ona je niz zaziva jedinstva u kojima se cijelo ljudsko biće povezuje s Kristom. Molitelj moli:

- da noge hode zajedno,
- da ruke budu skupljene u jedinstvu,
- da srca kucaju zajedno i duše budu u skladu,
- da misli budu kao jedno,
- da uši zajedno „slušaju tišinu“,
- da pogledi duboko prodru jedan u drugi.

Sve završava molbom da usne zajedno mole „da zadobijemo milosrđe od vječnoga Oca“. Time se već na početku najavljuje glavna tema emisije, **Božje milosrđe**.

magisterium.assessment: Molitva svetom Mihaelu vjerno odgovara katoličkoj molitvenoj predaji: ista je zazivna formulacija potvrđena u crkvenom obredu, a borbu protiv zla prikazuje kao oslanjanje na Božju vlast, ne na ljudsku moć. Zazivi Isusu za jedinstvo tijela, srca i misli mogu se razumjeti kao pobožan izraz sjedinjenja s Kristom i molitve za zajedništvo; u opisanom sadržaju nema očitog naukovnog problema.
magisterium.enrichment: Molitva svetom Mihaelu u službenom tekstu izričito moli za obranu od đavolskih zasjeda i za Božje izbavljenje, pa se ne radi o pripisivanju arkanđelu božanske vlasti nego o molitvi za njegov zagovor i pomoć pod Božjim vodstvom. Biblijska pozadina je duhovna borba opisana u Ef 6, na koju se poziva i starija crkvena molitva svetom Mihaelu. Slike zajedničkog hoda, mišljenja i molitve najbolje je čitati kao pjesnički govor o jedinstvu s Kristom i u njemu, a ne kao tvrdnju da čovjek gubi vlastitu osobnost.

magisterium.assessment_en: The prayer to Saint Michael faithfully corresponds to Catholic prayer tradition: the same invocative formulation is confirmed in Church rites, and it depicts the struggle against evil as relying on God's authority, not on human power. Invocations to Jesus for unity of body, heart, and thoughts can be understood as a devout expression of union with Christ and a prayer for communion; there is no obvious doctrinal problem in the described content.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The prayer to Saint Michael in the official text explicitly prays for defense against the snares of the devil and for God's deliverance, so it is not a matter of attributing divine authority to the archangel, but of praying for his intercession and help under God's guidance. The biblical background is the spiritual warfare described in Eph 6, which the older Church prayer to Saint Michael also references. The images of walking, thinking, and praying together are best read as poetic speech about unity with Christ and in him, and not as a claim that man loses his own personality.

sections.subtitle_en: Archangel Michael and the prayer that “our hearts beat together”
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar prays the prayer to Saint Michael the Archangel and proceeds to the prayer for unity with Jesus
sections.content_en:
The prayer of deliverance is followed by the classic **prayer to Saint Michael the Archangel**. Grebenar invokes him as the “commander of the heavenly host”. He begs him to defend the faithful “in battle against the malice and snares of the devil” and to be their protection. The prayer asks that Satan and other evil spirits, who “prowl about the world seeking the ruin of souls”, be cast into hell by the divine power and strength.

There follows a prayer of a different, tender tone, addressed to “sweet Jesus”. It is a series of invocations of unity in which the entire human being is connected with Christ. The prayer asks:

- that feet walk together,
- that hands be gathered in unity,
- that hearts beat together and souls be in harmony,
- that thoughts be as one,
- that ears together “listen to the silence”,
- that gazes deeply penetrate one another.

Everything ends with a petition that lips pray together “that we may obtain mercy from the Eternal Father”. In this way, the main theme of the broadcast, **God's mercy**, is already announced at the very beginning.

sections.subtitle: Posveta dvama Srcima: Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu i Presvetom Srcu Isusovu
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj izgovara posvetu Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu
sections.content:
Molitveni uvod nastavlja se dvjema posvetama.

U prvoj Vladimir Grebenar Presvetoj Djevici Mariji, „majci i kraljici“, posvećuje i predaje **„čitavo svoje biće, svoje misli, riječi i djela“**. Posveta ima jasnu nakanu: hvalu i slavu Presvetoga Trojstva, posvećenje Crkve i spasenje svijeta. U njoj se Mariji prepušta da „raspolaže“ moliteljem i svime što mu pripada, „sada i u vječnosti“.

Drugi dio posvete odnosi se na krsni poziv. Molitelj moli da dostojno živi svoje **krsno posvećenje** i da „neopozivo pripada svome Otkupitelju“. Moli i da poput Marije sluša poticaje Duha Svetoga, uz završni zaziv: „Neka se u meni i u svemu vrši volja Božja.“

Slijedi molitva **Presvetom Srcu Isusovu**, „izvoru svakoga dobra“. U njoj se nižu klanjanje, vjera, ufanje, ljubav i kajanje za grijehe. Molitelj Isusu poklanja svoje „siromašno srce“ i moli da ga učini poniznim, strpljivim i čistim.

Molitva završava nizom vrlo konkretnih molbi:

- zaštita u opasnostima,
- utjeha u nevoljama i žalostima,
- zdravlje tijela,
- blagoslov svega rada,
- **milost svete smrti**.

magisterium.assessment: Obje posvete su u skladu s katoličkom pobožnošću: Mariji se vjernik povjerava s izričitom nakanom slave Trojstva i spasenja, dok su klanjanje, pouzdanje, kajanje i molbe upućene Srcu Isusovu usmjerene Kristu. Izraz da Marija „raspolaže” moliteljem valja razumjeti kao čin povjerenja i zagovora, a ne kao pripisivanje Mariji božanske vlasti ili posredništva neovisnog o Kristu.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva prihvaća posvetu pojedinaca Marijinu Bezgrešnom Srcu, ali jasno čuva neusporedivu razliku između Krista, pravoga Boga, i Marije, stvorenja; marijanska posveta vodi vjernika Kristu i njegovu djelu spasenja. Molba da se živi krsno posvećenje dobro izražava cilj takvog predanja: život u milosti, molitvi, čistoći i izvršavanju kršćanskih dužnosti. Molbe za zdravlje, pomoć u nevolji i milost svete smrti primjerene su prošnje, pod uvjetom da se primaju u pouzdanju u Božju volju, a ne kao obećanje da će svaka željena vremenita korist biti zajamčena.

magisterium.assessment_en: Both consecrations are in accordance with Catholic devotion: the believer entrusts themselves to Mary with the explicit intention of the glory of the Trinity and salvation, while adoration, trust, repentance, and petitions addressed to the Heart of Jesus are directed to Christ. The phrase that Mary “disposes” of the person praying should be understood as an act of trust and intercession, and not as attributing divine authority or mediation independent of Christ to Mary.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church accepts the consecration of individuals to the Immaculate Heart of Mary, but clearly preserves the incomparable distinction between Christ, true God, and Mary, a creature; Marian consecration leads the believer to Christ and his work of salvation. The petition to live baptismal consecration well expresses the goal of such surrender: a life in grace, prayer, purity, and the fulfillment of Christian duties. Petitions for health, help in trouble, and the grace of a holy death are appropriate requests, provided they are received in trust in God's will, and not as a promise that every desired temporal benefit will be guaranteed.

sections.subtitle_en: Consecration to the two Hearts: to the Immaculate Heart of Mary and the Sacred Heart of Jesus
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host pronounces the consecration to the Immaculate Heart of Mary
sections.content_en:
The prayer introduction continues with two consecrations.

In the first, Vladimir Grebenar consecrates and surrenders **“his whole being, his thoughts, words, and deeds”** to the Blessed Virgin Mary, “mother and queen”. The consecration has a clear intention: the praise and glory of the Most Holy Trinity, the sanctification of the Church, and the salvation of the world. In it, Mary is granted to “dispose” of the prayer participant and everything that belongs to him, “now and in eternity”.

The second part of the consecration refers to the baptismal calling. The prayer participant asks to live his **baptismal consecration** worthily and to “belong irrevocably to his Redeemer”. He also prays that, like Mary, he may listen to the promptings of the Holy Spirit, with the concluding invocation: “May the will of God be done in me and in everything.”

There follows a prayer to the **Sacred Heart of Jesus**, the “fountain of every good”. In it follow adoration, faith, hope, love, and repentance for sins. The prayer participant offers Jesus his “poor heart” and asks to make it humble, patient, and pure.

The prayer concludes with a series of very concrete petitions:

- protection in dangers,
- consolation in afflictions and sorrows,
- bodily health,
- blessing of all work,
- **the grace of a holy death**.

sections.subtitle: Temelji vjere: Oče naš, Zdravo Marijo i Vjerovanje
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar moli Apostolsko vjerovanje
sections.content:
Prije Krunice Božanskom milosrđu Grebenar moli tri osnovne molitve kršćanske tradicije.

Prva je **Oče naš**, s molbama za dolazak Božjeg kraljevstva, vršenje Božje volje, svagdanji kruh, oproštenje i izbavljenje od zla. Druga je **Zdravo Marijo**, s pozdravom „milosti puna“ i molbom Majci Božjoj da moli za grešnike „sada i na času smrti naše“.

Treća je **Vjerovanje**, u kojem se sažeto ispovijedaju glavne istine vjere:

- vjera u Boga Oca svemogućega, Stvoritelja neba i zemlje,
- vjera u Isusa Krista, začetog po Duhu Svetom i rođenog od Marije Djevice,
- njegova muka pod Poncijem Pilatom, smrt, ukop i silazak nad pakao,
- uskrsnuće treći dan, uzašašće na nebesa i ponovni dolazak „suditi žive i mrtve“,
- vjera u Duha Svetoga, svetu Crkvu katoličku, općinstvo svetih, oproštenje grijeha, uskrsnuće tijela i život vječni.

Ove molitve čine prijelaz između uvodnih molitava i krunica koje slijede.

magisterium.assessment: Opis Očenaša, Zdravomarije i Apostolskog vjerovanja u bitnome je vjeran katoličkoj vjeri i molitvenoj predaji. Prikladno ističe da Vjerovanje sažeto ispovijeda temeljne istine vjere, a Očenaš zauzima posebno mjesto među kršćanskim molitvama.
magisterium.enrichment: Očenaš nije samo popis prošnji: prema Katekizmu, on je „sažetak cijelog Evanđelja“ te uči vjernika što smije moliti i kojim redom oblikovati svoje želje. Zdravomarija povezuje anđeoski pozdrav Mariji s Elizabetinim riječima te molbom za njezin zagovor, dok Vjerovanje ispovijeda vjeru Crkve u Boga, Kristovo djelo spasenja, Duha Svetoga i budući život.
magisterium.assessment_en: The description of the Our Father, Hail Mary, and Apostles' Creed is essentially faithful to Catholic faith and prayer tradition. It appropriately emphasizes that the Creed concisely professes the fundamental truths of faith, and the Our Father holds a special place among Christian prayers.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Our Father is not just a list of petitions: according to the Catechism, it is “the summary of the whole Gospel” and teaches the believer what one may pray for and in what order to shape one's desires. The Hail Mary combines the angelic greeting to Mary with Elizabeth's words and a petition for her intercession, while the Creed professes the Church's faith in God, Christ's work of salvation, the Holy Spirit, and the life to come.

sections.subtitle_en: Foundations of the faith: Our Father, Hail Mary, and the Creed
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar prays the Apostles' Creed
sections.content_en:
Before the Chaplet of Divine Mercy, Grebenar prays three basic prayers of the Christian tradition.

The first is the **Our Father**, with petitions for the coming of God's kingdom, the doing of God's will, daily bread, forgiveness, and deliverance from evil. The second is the **Hail Mary**, with the greeting “full of grace” and a petition to the Mother of God to pray for sinners “now and at the hour of our death”.

The third is the **Creed**, in which the main truths of faith are concisely confessed:

- faith in God the Father almighty, Creator of heaven and earth,
- faith in Jesus Christ, conceived by the Holy Spirit and born of the Virgin Mary,
- his passion under Pontius Pilate, death, burial, and descent into hell,
- resurrection on the third day, ascension into heaven, and coming again “to judge the living and the dead”,
- faith in the Holy Spirit, the holy Catholic Church, the communion of saints, the forgiveness of sins, the resurrection of the body, and life everlasting.

These prayers form a transition between the opening prayers and the rosaries that follow.

sections.subtitle: „Po njegovoj pregorkoj muci“: Krunica Božanskom milosrđu
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj moli Krunicu Božanskom milosrđu i ponavlja zaziv za milosrđe nama i cijelome svijetu
sections.content:
Središnji dio ovog segmenta, sukladno nazivu serijala *Milosrđe Božje*, jest **Krunica Božanskom milosrđu**. Molitva je izgrađena na dvjema rečenicama koje se izmjenjuju.

Na početku svake desetice Vladimir Grebenar izgovara prikazanje Ocu:

> „Vječni Oče, prikazujemo ti tijelo i krv, dušu i božanstvo preljubljenoga sina tvojega, Gospodina našega Isusa Krista, kao zadovoljštinu za grijehe naše i cijeloga svijeta.“

Nakon toga više puta ponavlja zaziv: **„Po njegovoj pregorkoj muci, budi milosrdan nama i cijelome svijetu.“**

Taj se ritam ponavlja kroz pet ciklusa, otprilike od petе do jedanaeste minute emisije. Jednolično ponavljanje molitvu pretvara u meditaciju o Kristovoj muci kao izvoru milosrđa. Nakana nije usmjerena samo na molitelja, nego na „cijeli svijet“.

Krunica završava trostrukim zazivom **„Sveti Bože, sveti jaki Bože, sveti besmrtni Bože, smiluj se nama i cijelomu svijetu“**. Slijedi i molitva: „O krvi i vodo, što potekoste iz srca Isusova, kao izvor milosrđa za nas, uzdam se u tebe.“

Na kraju Grebenar zaziva Mariju kao **majku milosrđa** i tri puta ponavlja kratku ispovijest: **„Isuse, uzdam se u tebe.“**

magisterium.assessment: Prikaz Krunice Božanskog milosrđa uglavnom je usklađen s katoličkim naukom: usredotočuje se na Kristovu muku, moli za milosrđe za cijeli svijet i izražava pouzdanje u Isusa. Izraz „kao zadovoljštinu“ valja razumjeti u svjetlu jedinstvene otkupiteljske žrtve Krista, a ne kao da bi se Božje milosrđe trebalo prisiliti ili kao da bi molitva dodavala nešto nedostatno Kristovu djelu.
magisterium.enrichment: U ovoj pobožnosti vjernici prikazuju Ocu Kristovo tijelo, krv, dušu i božanstvo te se sjedinjuju s njegovom žrtvom moleći za sebe i cijeli svijet; njezin je temelj Kristova ljubav i Očevo milosrđe, a ne nepovjerenje u Boga. Crkveno tumačenje Kristove muke naglašava da se otkupljenje i milosrđe objavljuju u njegovoj smrti na križu, gdje pravda izvire iz ljubavi i donosi spasenje.

magisterium.assessment_en: The presentation of the Chaplet of Divine Mercy is mostly aligned with Catholic teaching: it focuses on Christ's passion, prays for mercy for the whole world, and expresses trust in Jesus. The phrase “in expiation” should be understood in light of the unique redemptive sacrifice of Christ, and not as if God's mercy should be forced or as if prayer added something deficient to Christ's work.
magisterium.enrichment_en: In this devotion, the faithful offer to the Father the body, blood, soul, and divinity of Christ, and unite with his sacrifice praying for themselves and the whole world; its foundation is Christ's love and the Father's mercy, and not mistrust in God. The Church's interpretation of Christ's passion emphasizes that redemption and mercy are revealed in his death on the cross, where justice springs from love and brings salvation.

sections.subtitle_en: “For the sake of His sorrowful Passion”: Chaplet of Divine Mercy
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host prays the Chaplet of Divine Mercy and repeats the invocation for mercy on us and on the whole world
sections.content_en:
The central part of this segment, in accordance with the title of the series *Milosrđe Božje*, is the **Chaplet of Divine Mercy**. The prayer is built on two alternating sentences.

At the beginning of each decade, Vladimir Grebenar recites the offering to the Father:

> “Eternal Father, we offer You the Body and Blood, Soul and Divinity of Your dearly beloved Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, in atonement for our sins and those of the whole world.”

After that, he repeats multiple times the invocation: **“For the sake of His sorrowful Passion, have mercy on us and on the whole world.”**

That rhythm is repeated through five cycles, roughly from the fifth to the eleventh minute of the broadcast. The uniform repetition transforms the prayer into a meditation on Christ's Passion as a fountain of mercy. The intention is not directed only toward the prayer participant, but toward the “whole world”.

The Chaplet concludes with the triple invocation **“Holy God, Holy Mighty One, Holy Immortal One, have mercy on us and on the whole world”**. There also follows the prayer: “O Blood and Water, which gushed forth from the Heart of Jesus as a fount of mercy for us, I trust in You.”

At the end, Grebenar invokes Mary as the **mother of mercy** and repeats three times the short profession: **“Jesus, I trust in You.”**

sections.subtitle: Litanije Božanskom milosrđu: od stvaranja svijeta do duša u čistilištu
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar moli litanije Božanskom milosrđu s ponavljanim odgovorom „uzdam se u tebe“
sections.content:
Nakon krunice slijede **litanije Božanskom milosrđu**. Počinju uobičajenim litanijskim uvodom „Gospodine, smiluj se. Kriste, smiluj se“. Zatim se nižu zazivi Ocu, Sinu Otkupitelju svijeta, Duhu Svetom i Presvetom Trojstvu.

Glavni dio litanija opisuje Božje milosrđe kroz cijelu povijest spasenja. Svaki zaziv završava odgovorom **„uzdam se u tebe“**. Vladimir Grebenar Božje milosrđe naziva, među ostalim:

- **neshvatljivom tajnom Presvetoga Trojstva** i izrazom Božje najveće moći,
- milosrđem koje se objavilo u stvaranju nebeskih duhova i koje je ljude **iz ništavila pozvalo u život**,
- milosrđem koje obuhvaća čitav svijet i daruje besmrtan život,
- zaštitom od „zasluženih kazna“ i oslobođenjem od bijede grijeha,
- milosrđem koje se izlijeva **iz rana Kristovih** i izvire iz Presvetoga Srca,
- milosrđem koje je ljudima dalo Presvetu Djevicu za **majku milosrđa**,
- milosrđem vidljivim u ustanovljenju Crkve i sakramenata, „neograničenim“ u krštenju i pokori te „neizmjernim“ u sakramentu oltara i svećeništva.

Drugi niz zaziva usmjeren je na čovjeka u njegovim potrebama. Milosrđe se zaziva kao ono koje obraća grešnike, posvećuje pravednike i usavršuje svete. Ono je i vrelo bolesnicima i patnicima, utjeha onima „skršena srca“, ufanje onima koji očajavaju i **mir umirućih**. Litanije spominju i milosrđe koje čuva od paklenoga ognja te olakšava patnje **dušama u čistilištu**. Na kraju ga nazivaju „neiscrpivim izvorom čudesa“.

Zaključak čine riječi: „Bog je milosrdan i pun samilosti, spor na srđbu i pun dobrote. Zato ću dovijeka klicati milosrđu Božjemu.“ Slijedi završna molitva vječnom Bogu, čije je milosrđe „neistraživo“ i čije je blago smilovanja „neiscrpivo“. U njoj Grebenar moli da vjernici **u teškim trenucima ne očajavaju i ne budu obeshrabreni**. Umjesto toga, neka se s velikim pouzdanjem predaju Božjoj volji, „koja je sama ljubav i smilovanje“. Molitva se zaključuje po Isusu Kristu, **„kralju milosrđa“**.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je uglavnom potpuno usklađen s katoličkom vjerom: zazivi Božjem milosrđu, povjerenje u Boga i molitva za pokojne odgovaraju pobožnosti svete Faustine, a Crkva tu pobožnost razumije u svjetlu Kristove smrti i uskrsnuća. Izraz predanja Božjoj volji ispravno je prikazan kao pouzdanje u Božju ljubav, a ne kao razlog za očaj ili obeshrabrenje.
concerns: Molitvu da Bog štiti od zasluženih kazna i pomaže u teškim trenucima valja razumjeti kao pouzdanje u njegovo milosrđe, a ne kao tvrdnju da vjernik neće iskusiti posljedice grijeha ili da mu je obećano uklanjanje svake zemaljske patnje.
magisterium.enrichment: Litanije svete Faustine izričito nazivaju Božje milosrđe tajnom Presvetoga Trojstva, povezuju ga s Kristovim ranama, ustanovljenjem Crkve i sakramentima te ponavljaju odgovor „uzdam se u tebe“. Crkvena uputa smješta pobožnost Božanskom milosrđu u uskrsno otajstvo: Kristova smrt i uskrsnuće izvor su oproštenja grijeha i obnovljene radosti otkupljenja.

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is mostly fully aligned with the Catholic faith: invocations to Divine Mercy, trust in God, and prayer for the deceased correspond to the devotion of Saint Faustina, and the Church understands this devotion in the light of Christ's death and resurrection. The expression of surrender to God's will is correctly presented as trust in God's love, and not as a reason for despair or discouragement.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The litany of Saint Faustina explicitly calls Divine Mercy a mystery of the Most Holy Trinity, links it to Christ's wounds, the establishment of the Church, and the sacraments, and repeats the response “I trust in you”. The Church's instruction places the devotion to Divine Mercy in the paschal mystery: Christ's death and resurrection are the source of forgiveness of sins and the renewed joy of redemption.
concerns_en: The prayer that God protect from deserved punishments and help in difficult moments should be understood as trust in his mercy, and not as a claim that the believer will not experience the consequences of sin or that the removal of every earthly suffering is promised to them.

sections.subtitle_en: Litany of Divine Mercy: from the creation of the world to the souls in purgatory
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar prays the Litany of Divine Mercy with the repeated response “I trust in You”
sections.content_en:
After the chaplet follows the **Litany of Divine Mercy**. It begins with the customary litany opening “Lord, have mercy. Christ, have mercy”. Then follow invocations to the Father, the Son Redeemer of the world, the Holy Spirit, and the Most Holy Trinity.

The main part of the litany describes God's mercy throughout the entire history of salvation. Each invocation concludes with the response **“I trust in You”**. Vladimir Grebenar calls God's mercy, among other things:

- the **incomprehensible mystery of the Most Holy Trinity** and the expression of God's greatest power,
- the mercy that revealed itself in the creation of heavenly spirits and that **called men out of nothingness into life**,
- the mercy that encompasses the whole world and bestows immortal life,
- protection from “deserved punishments” and deliverance from the misery of sin,
- the mercy that pours forth **from the wounds of Christ** and flows from the Sacred Heart,
- the mercy that gave men the Blessed Virgin as the **mother of mercy**,
- the mercy visible in the institution of the Church and the sacraments, “unlimited” in baptism and penance and “immense” in the sacrament of the altar and priesthood.

The second series of invocations is directed toward man in his needs. Mercy is invoked as that which converts sinners, sanctifies the just, and perfects the holy. It is also a source for the sick and the suffering, consolation for those of “broken heart”, hope for those who despair, and the **peace of the dying**. The litany also mentions the mercy that preserves from the fire of hell and relieves the sufferings of **souls in purgatory**. In the end, they call it an “inexhaustible source of miracles”.

The conclusion consists of the words: “God is merciful and full of compassion, slow to anger, and full of goodness. Therefore I will sing of the mercy of God forever.” There follows a concluding prayer to the eternal God, whose mercy is “unfathomable” and whose treasure of compassion is “inexhaustible”. In it, Grebenar prays that the faithful **in difficult moments may not despair or be discouraged**. Instead, let them surrender with great confidence to God's will, “which is love and compassion itself”. The prayer concludes through Jesus Christ, the **“king of mercy”**.

sections.subtitle: Gospina krunica: slavna otajstva Uskrsnuća i Uzašašća
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj najavljuje Gospinu krunicu i prvo slavno otajstvo „Koji je od mrtvih uskrsnuo“
sections.content:
Riječima „Slijedi Gospina krunica“ Vladimir Grebenar prelazi na drugi veliki molitveni blok, Gospinu krunicu sa **slavnim otajstvima**.

Svako otajstvo ima istu strukturu. Najprije se najavi otajstvo i moli Oče naš. Slijedi deset Zdravo Marija, a nakon njih Slava Ocu. Svaku deseticu zaključuje molitva:

> „O moj Isuse, oprosti nam naše grijehe. Očuvaj nas od paklenoga ognja. Dovedi u raj sve duše, osobito one kojima je najpotrebnije tvoje milosrđe.“

**Prvo otajstvo, „Koji je od mrtvih uskrsnuo“**, posvećeno je Kristovu uskrsnuću, temeljnom događaju kršćanske vjere. **Drugo otajstvo, „Koji je na nebo uzašao“**, započinje oko dvadesete minute i usmjerava molitelje prema Kristovu uzašašću.

Završni zaziv svake desetice, s molbom za duše „kojima je najpotrebnije tvoje milosrđe“, povezuje Gospinu krunicu s glavnom temom emisije, Božjim milosrđem.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak vjerno prikazuje uobičajenu strukturu krunice i njezina slavna otajstva te ispravno usmjerava pozornost na stvarno Kristovo uskrsnuće i uzašašće. Molitveni zaziv za duše kojima je najpotrebnije Božje milosrđe izražava kršćansku prošnju i povjerenje, bez tvrdnje da čovjek može unaprijed znati Božji sud.
magisterium.enrichment: Uskrsnuće nije samo završetak Isusove muke nego središte kršćanske vjere; u Lk 24 uskrsli Krist učenicima pokazuje da je živ, tumači im Pisma i šalje ih kao svjedoke. U uzašašću se Krist vraća Ocu, a slavna otajstva krunice pozivaju vjernike da u Kristovoj slavi produbljuju nadu i žive novi život u njemu.

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage faithfully portrays the usual structure of the rosary and its glorious mysteries and correctly directs attention to the real resurrection and ascension of Christ. The prayerful invocation for souls in most need of God's mercy expresses Christian petition and trust, without claiming that man can know God's judgment in advance.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Resurrection is not merely the conclusion of Jesus' passion but the center of the Christian faith; in Lk 24 the risen Christ shows the disciples that he is alive, interprets the Scriptures to them, and sends them as witnesses. In the Ascension, Christ returns to the Father, and the glorious mysteries of the Rosary invite believers to deepen hope in Christ's glory and live a new life in him.

sections.subtitle_en: Our Lady's Rosary: glorious mysteries of the Resurrection and Ascension
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host announces Our Lady's Rosary and the first glorious mystery “Who rose from the dead”
sections.content_en:
With the words “Next is Our Lady's Rosary”, Vladimir Grebenar moves to the second major prayer block, Our Lady's Rosary with the **glorious mysteries**.

Every mystery has the same structure. First, the mystery is announced and the Our Father is prayed. Ten Hail Marys follow, and after them the Glory Be. Each decade concludes with the prayer:

> “O my Jesus, forgive us our sins. Save us from the fires of hell. Lead all souls to heaven, especially those who are in most need of Your mercy.”

**The first mystery, “Who rose from the dead”**, is dedicated to Christ's resurrection, the foundational event of the Christian faith. **The second mystery, “Who ascended into heaven”**, begins around the twentieth minute and directs the prayer participants toward Christ's ascension.

The concluding invocation of each decade, with the petition for souls “who are in most need of Your mercy”, connects Our Lady's Rosary with the main theme of the broadcast, God's mercy.

sections.subtitle: Silazak Duha Svetoga, Uznesenje i Krunjenje Marijino
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar najavljuje četvrto slavno otajstvo o Marijinu uznesenju na nebo
sections.content:
Krunica se nastavlja istim ritmom kroz preostala tri slavna otajstva.

**Treće otajstvo, „Koji je Duha Svetoga poslao“**, Grebenar najavljuje nešto nakon dvadeset i treće minute. U središtu je silazak Duha Svetoga, kojega su uvodne molitve već zazivale u posveti Mariji: da molitelj poput nje „sluša poticaje Duha Svetoga“.

**Četvrto otajstvo, „Koji je tebe, Djevice, na nebo uznio“**, posvećeno je Marijinu uznesenju. **Peto otajstvo, „Koji je tebe, Djevice, na nebu okrunio“**, govori o Marijinu krunjenju. Ta dva otajstva odgovaraju zazivima s početka emisije, u kojima se Marija naziva „majkom i kraljicom“.

Svako otajstvo zaključuje se kao i prethodna. Nakon Slava Ocu slijedi molba Isusu da oprosti grijehe, očuva od paklenoga ognja i dovede u raj sve duše, osobito one kojima je njegovo milosrđe najpotrebnije.

magisterium.assessment: Opis slavnih otajstava i molitva za duše u skladu su s katoličkim naukom: Crkva ispovijeda da je Marija na svršetku zemaljskog života uznesena dušom i tijelom u nebesku slavu te od Gospodina uzvišena kao Kraljica, a apostoli su prije Pedesetnice molili zajedno s njom.
magisterium.enrichment: Katoličko tumačenje povezuje Marijino uznesenje i krunjenje s njezinim jedinstvenim udioništvom u Kristovoj pobjedi nad grijehom i smrću, a ne s neovisnom moći odvojeno od njezina Sina. U navedenom odlomku otajstva su sažeto imenovana; sama tvrdnja o uznesenju nije izravno pripovjeđena u biblijskom tekstu, nego je predstavljena kao nauk Crkve.
magisterium.assessment_en: The description of the glorious mysteries and prayer for souls are in accordance with Catholic teaching: the Church professes that at the end of her earthly life Mary was assumed body and soul into heavenly glory and exalted by the Lord as Queen, and the apostles prayed together with her before Pentecost.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic interpretation links Mary's assumption and coronation with her unique participation in Christ's victory over sin and death, and not with independent power separate from her Son. In the cited passage, the mysteries are concisely named; the claim of the assumption itself is not directly narrated in the biblical text, but is presented as a teaching of the Church.

sections.subtitle_en: Descent of the Holy Spirit, Assumption, and Coronation of Mary
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar announces the fourth glorious mystery of Mary's assumption into heaven
sections.content_en:
The Rosary continues with the same rhythm through the remaining three glorious mysteries.

**The third mystery, “Who sent the Holy Spirit”**, Grebenar announces shortly after the twenty-third minute. In the center is the descent of the Holy Spirit, whom the opening prayers already invoked in the consecration to Mary: that the prayer participant, like her, may “listen to the promptings of the Holy Spirit”.

**The fourth mystery, “Who took thee, Virgin, into heaven”**, is dedicated to Mary's assumption. **The fifth mystery, “Who crowned thee, Virgin, in heaven”**, speaks of Mary's coronation. Those two mysteries correspond to the invocations from the beginning of the broadcast, in which Mary is called “mother and queen”.

Each mystery concludes like the previous ones. After the Glory Be follows the petition to Jesus to forgive sins, preserve from the fire of hell, and lead all souls to heaven, especially those who are in most need of His mercy.

sections.subtitle: „Zdravo, Kraljice, majko milosrđa“: završni zaziv molitvenog dijela
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj moli završnu molitvu „Zdravo Kraljice“ na kraju Gospine krunice
sections.content:
Molitveni dio završava antifonom **„Zdravo Kraljice“**. Vladimir Grebenar u njoj Mariju pozdravlja kao **„majku milosrđa, život, slast i ufanje naše“**.

Molitva opisuje vjernike kao „prognane sinove Evine“. Oni uzdišu „tugujući i plačući u ovoj suznoj dolini“. Mariju nazivaju zagovornicom i mole je da na njih svrne „svoje milostive oči“. Nakon „ovoga progona“ neka im pokaže Isusa, „blagoslovljeni plod utrobe svoje“.

Završni uzvik glasi: „O blaga, o mila, o slatka Djevice Marijo. Amen.“ Tako se zatvara molitveni okvir koji je počeo borbenom molitvom oslobođenja, a završava utjecanjem Mariji kao majci milosrđa. Naziv „majka milosrđa“ ponavlja se kroz cijeli ovaj dio emisije, od Krunice Božanskom milosrđu, preko litanija, do završnog pozdrava Kraljici. Nakon toga emisija prelazi na tumačenje svete riječi.

magisterium.assessment: Zazivi iz molitve „Zdravo, Kraljice“ u skladu su s katoličkom marijanskom pobožnošću: Crkva Mariju naziva Majkom milosrđa, zagovornicom i Kraljicom te moli za njezin zagovor.
magisterium.enrichment: Marijin zagovor ne zamjenjuje Kristovo jedinstveno posredništvo niti djeluje neovisno o njemu: crpi snagu iz Kristova otkupiteljskog djela i usmjerava vjernike prema njemu. Izraz „majka milosrđa“ stoga govori o Marijinoj majčinskoj blizini i zagovoru, dok je Isus, „blagoslovljeni plod“ njezine utrobe, lice Božjeg milosrđa.

citations.document_author: Dicastery for the Doctrine of the Faith

magisterium.assessment_en: The invocations from the prayer “Hail, Holy Queen” are in accordance with Catholic Marian devotion: the Church calls Mary Mother of Mercy, advocate, and Queen, and prays for her intercession.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Mary's intercession does not replace Christ's unique mediation nor does it act independently of it: it draws its power from Christ's redemptive work and directs believers toward him. The expression “mother of mercy” therefore speaks of Mary's maternal closeness and intercession, while Jesus, the “blessed fruit” of her womb, is the face of God's mercy.

sections.subtitle_en: “Hail, Holy Queen, mother of mercy”: concluding invocation of the prayer section
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host prays the concluding prayer “Hail Holy Queen” at the end of Our Lady's Rosary
sections.content_en:
The prayer section ends with the antiphon **“Hail Holy Queen”**. In it, Vladimir Grebenar greets Mary as **“mother of mercy, our life, our sweetness, and our hope”**.

The prayer describes the faithful as “poor banished children of Eve”. They sigh, “mourning and weeping in this valley of tears”. They call Mary an advocate and beg her to turn “her merciful eyes” toward them. After “this our exile”, let her show them Jesus, “the blessed fruit of thy womb”.

The concluding exclamation reads: “O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary. Amen.” Thus closes the prayer framework that began with a combative prayer of deliverance, and ends with recourse to Mary as the mother of mercy. The title “mother of mercy” is repeated throughout this entire part of the broadcast, from the Chaplet of Divine Mercy, across the litany, to the final greeting to the Queen. After that, the broadcast moves on to the interpretation of the holy word.
